chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from one of the two of them, peace be upon them; he said:
I asked him about a woman in iḥrām when she becomes pure: may she wash her head with al-khiṭmī? He said: "Water suffices for her."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةِ: a woman in the state of iḥrām for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.بِالْخِطْمِيِّ: with al-khiṭmī, a cleansing plant used for washing

ai.seo_question: Can a woman in iḥrām wash her head with cleansing herbs after becoming pure from menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman in the state of iḥrām who becomes pure from menstruation. The Imam عليه السلام states that water alone is sufficient for washing her head, indicating restriction from using scented or special cleansing substances in this state.
